Ashwin Uppal has joined EssilorLuxottica as Head of Marketing, Greater India, and will be part of the company’s leadership team led by Venu Ambati, President, Greater India.

Uppal brings more than 24 years of experience across FMCG, retail, technology, entertainment and alternative assets, with expertise spanning marketing strategy, brand building, sales and innovation. Over the course of his career, he has worked across more than 200 brands in over 100 countries and multiple categories.

Before joining EssilorLuxottica, Uppal served as Global Chief Marketing Officer at RMZ, where he led the group’s global marketing mandate across businesses spanning real estate, consumer, sports, retail, hospitality, logistics, AI and data centres.

Earlier in his career, Uppal held leadership roles at Reckitt, Godrej Consumer Products, L’Oréal, Jio and Baskin-Robbins, working across brand building and business transformation. He has also worked with Nestlé and Lowe Lintas, contributing to campaigns for brands including Nescafé, Maggi, Lifebuoy, Idea and Britannia.
